editorial:
Imagine moving to a quiet, pretty neighborhood to get your life back together, only to find out your neighbors are actually monsters. That is exactly what happens to Ivory and his wife, Zoë. Ivory is trying really hard to stay sober, but the stress of their new home makes it tough. The movie starts off feeling like a normal drama about a couple starting over, but it quickly turns into a scary fight for survival. You will feel for Ivory as he tries to keep it together while the people next door start acting very strange and hungry. It is a wild ride that mixes personal struggle with some really creepy scares.

The acting is top-notch and the twists will definitely keep you guessing until the end. While some parts of the middle feel a bit slow, the final act is non-stop action. You should definitely check this out if you love stories where the suburbs hide a dark secret.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, you find out the neighbors are part of a cult that feeds on people who are struggling with addiction. Ivory has to fight his way out of the neighborhood while refusing to drink, even when things get desperate. He and Zoë barely escape after setting the neighborhood association's headquarters on fire. The big twist is that the real estate agent was the leader of the cult all along.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves creepy neighbor stories and high-stakes horror.
